sloka: प्रत्ययार्थं तु लोकानां त्रयाणां सत्यसंश्रयः ।उपेक्षे चापि वैदेहीं प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम् ।। ६.१२१.१७ ।।
transliteration: pratyayārthaṁ tu lokānāṁ trayāṇāṁ satyasaṁśrayaḥ ।upekṣe cāpi vaidehīṁ praviśantīṁ hutāśanam ।। 6.121.17 ।।

translations.english: " As I am a follower of truth only, to convince the three worlds I was disregarding Vaidehi entering fire."
